verdict.rationale: Gitea's docs state it supports over 20 public or private package types, including Container, Maven, npm and PyPI. A community user independently confirms the 1.17 package registry let them replace Verdaccio, a self-hosted npm registry. missing for 10: in-depth per-format documentation of publish/consume workflows and private-access authentication, and hands-on corroboration beyond npm (e.g. PyPI, Maven, container images).

support.subject: As a developer, I can publish and consume public or private packages and container images in many formats such as npm, PyPI, and Maven

citations.quote: Gitea supports over 20 different types of public or private software package management, including Cargo, Chef, Composer, Conan, Conda, Container, Helm, Maven, npm, NuGet, Pub, PyPI, RubyGems, Vagrant, and more.
Another user says the 1.17 package registry lets them ditch Verdaccio.
